summary: -i bounds the timed host loop dispatching a scalar or warp launch once per iteration when local blocks exist. Work-balanced boundaries assign contiguous ordered rows from zero through numRows, and each rank's kernel traverses its CSR rows. The warm-up is before MPI_Wtime.

source_evidence.claim: The kernels cover local rows and their CSR entries. -i stores iterations; monotone boundaries finish at numRows and define localRows. Conditional warm-up precedes timing; timed dispatch loops once per iter.

compiled_evidence.claim: MPI_Wtime brackets the repeated main launch path; host loop control increments and compares the iteration counter while dispatching selected scalar/warp stubs.
